method: Disposition is inherited from the live REQ coverage ledger: any scenario mapped to an open software-closure REQ is partial; otherwise its mapped REQs are treated as implemented. This is a requirement-level code/evidence crosswalk, not proof that an exact planned scenario passed.
executionStatusRule: The frozen design catalogs and release-applicability ledger remain unchanged; every exact planned scenario remains not_run.
